summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a Nasdaq-listed clinical-stage Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, incorporating a September 11, 2026 press release announcing enrollment of the first two patients with Alcohol Use Disorder at Hadassah Medical Center in Jerusalem in the ongoing CMND-100 clinical trial. The trial evaluates safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and preliminary efficacy of the company's non-hallucinogenic psychedelic-derived neuroplastogen candidate. No financial terms, securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine clinical milestone update, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
